english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for marble rock in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.english: The kitchen countertop is made of marble, so it’s quite easy to clean.
examples.traditional: 廚房個枱面用雲石整，清潔起上嚟幾方便。
